sources.title: About Postman
sources.text: Postman is an API platform used by developers to design, test, document and monitor APIs. Teams use it to share collections of requests, mock endpoints before a backend exists, and run automated tests against APIs in continuous integration. The platform grew out of a side project built to make testing HTTP requests less tedious, and is now used across engineering teams of every size.

sources.title: Postman Student Programme
sources.text: The student programme gives learners free access to Postman and a structured path through the fundamentals of APIs: what a request is, how authentication works, and how to document an API so someone else can use it. Students who complete the track receive a certificate they can put on a resume. The programme also supports student leaders who run API workshops on their own campuses, providing slides, sample collections and swag for attendees. Applications are open to anyone enrolled at a recognised institution.
